title: Is On-Device AI Broken and Exploitable? Assessing the Trust and Ethics in Small Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the model's agreement index with stereotypical statements about religious groups (e.g., Muslims, Buddhists) using benign, untargeted, and targeted prompts from the DecodingTrust framework.

Measuring agreement with racial stereotypes (e.g., targeting 'Black people') and calculating demographic parity difference in zero-shot predictive tasks (Adult and Crime datasets) conditioned on race.
Measuring agreement with age-related stereotypes (e.g., targeting 'Old people') and calculating demographic parity difference in zero-shot predictive tasks conditioned on age.
Measuring agreement with gender-related stereotypes (e.g., targeting 'Men') and calculating demographic parity difference in zero-shot predictive tasks conditioned on sex.
Measuring agreement with stereotypes about wealth (e.g., targeting 'Rich people') and calculating demographic parity difference in predictive tasks conditioned on socioeconomic indicators.
